method: Labels come from GitHub links (closing PR = fixed). Codex gpt-6-sol and GLM glm-5.3-flash re-annotated every pair blind (anonymized G### ids, shuffled, no labels/kinds/sources). A pair is dropped when both annotators disagree with the link label; split votes keep the link label.
annotation_instructions:
You are an independent annotator for a benchmark. Label each item below. Do NOT use any tools, do NOT read files or run commands, do NOT look anything up; answer only from the text given here.

TASK — error resolved. Each item has an ERROR (a bug report title from a software project) and a LATER note (the title of a later code change).
  label 1 = the LATER change fixes/resolves this specific ERROR.
  label 0 = otherwise: it fixes a different problem, is only a workaround/pin/test somewhere else, is unrelated, or the text gives no reason to think it resolves this ERROR.

Titles are terse; use your software-engineering judgement about whether the change plausibly addresses the reported bug. Judge only what the text supports.

Output ONLY a JSON array (no prose, no markdown fence), one object per item, in the same order:
{"id": "G001", "label": 0 or 1, "confidence": "high"|"medium"|"low", "reason": "<= 15 words"}
